projectAiResearch.forecastDetails: We assume standard processing, a short question and no reused input. Regional fees and fees for storing reusable input are not included. We estimate input length from the size of your text, including the answer-language instruction; DataForSEO may count it differently. Answer cost uses your chosen length limit, but reasoning and web search may generate more text. An ongoing request may exceed the warning threshold; DataForSEO’s usage record determines the final charge.
